title: FIDS Data Source Anomaly — Gate B4

fields.subject: FIDS Data Source Anomaly — Gate B4
fields.description: We checked the FIDS server. The data stream from the AODB is actually sending 'Miami'. It's not a display error; the source data changed. Passengers at Gate B4 are still being directed to Miami, but the actual flight is to Minneapolis. The AODB has not been updated to reflect the correct destination. This is not a display glitch. The feed from the AODB is corrupted or tampered with.

activity.author: IT Lead
activity.text: Confirmed: FIDS is pulling from AODB. Source data shows 'Miami' as destination. No manual update made. AODB logs to be reviewed.

activity.author: IT Helpdesk
activity.text: Follow-up on Ticket #4492. The vending machine issue was isolated to Concourse B, VEND-B02-01. No network or firmware anomalies detected. Suspect local hardware failure. Reassigned to Facilities for cleanup.

activity.author: IT Helpdesk
activity.text: New ticket received from monitoring: FIDS is displaying wrong destination for Gate B4. Initial report from Gate B4 agent.

instructorNote: This inject escalates the data integrity threat. IT must investigate AODB logs for anomalies. Watch for overconfidence in dismissing the issue as a 'one-off' error.
